blocks.text: Have you ever read a story and wondered what the main point was? Understanding the main idea of a passage is essential for effective reading.

blocks.markdown: Comprehension involves reading a passage and understanding its meaning. This skill helps you grasp the main idea and details, making it easier to answer questions about the text.

blocks.title: What is Comprehension?
blocks.text: Comprehension is the ability to understand and interpret what you read. It involves identifying the main idea, details, and vocabulary used in the text.

blocks.markdown: When you read a passage, look for the main idea, which is the central point the author wants to convey. Supporting details help explain or enhance the main idea.

blocks.title: Identifying the Main Idea
blocks.prompt: Read the following passage and identify its main idea: 'The sun rises in the east and sets in the west. It provides light and warmth, which are essential for life on Earth.'

steps.text: Identify the key points in the passage.
Determine what the passage is mainly about.

blocks.answer: The main idea is that the sun is crucial for life on Earth.

blocks.markdown: To answer factual questions, refer back to the passage. Look for specific information that directly answers the question.

blocks.title: Tips for Answering Questions
blocks.text: Always read the questions carefully and refer back to the passage to find the answers. Look for keywords in the questions that match the passage.

points: Understanding the main idea helps in answering comprehension questions.
Always refer back to the passage for factual questions.
